image_description: A top-down view of a dark blue, textured object resembling a compact cassette tape. The object has the general rectangular shape with rounded corners typical of a cassette. It features two circular cutouts and a central rectangular window, mimicking the spool windows of a real cassette. A paper label is affixed to the lower half, containing illegible, gibberish text that attempts to mimic track listings. The surface texture appears to be a coarse fabric or felt rather than smooth plastic, and the edges show signs of fraying or softness inconsistent with rigid plastic molding.
